slides.text:
How Society Programs You Without You Noticing

(The Mirror Method)

1. Repetition

“Sixty-two thousand four hundred repetitions make one truth.” – Aldous Huxley, Brave New World

You didn't choose most of what you want.

You heard it
• in ads
• in songs
• at the dinner table

until it felt like YOUR idea.

No one talks about this -

Programming doesn't feel like programming.

It feels like
• “just being realistic”
• “that's how life works”
• “everyone does it”

The best conditioning feels like COMMON SENSE.

2. The Mirror

Pick one thing you want right now. A car. A title. A body. A number in your account.

Ask:
• When did I first want this?
• Who showed it to me?
• Would I still want it if nobody could see it?

Write the answers down.

3. The final framework

How to rewrite the program:

1. CATCH every “I should…”

2. TRACE where it came from

3. QUESTION if it's still yours

4. CHOOSE: keep it or delete it

4. Live from choice

Remember - you can't escape every influence.

But you can stop running on DEFAULT SETTINGS.

A chosen life beats an inherited one every time.

This is the Key.

Save this and run the Mirror test tonight.
